title: Al-Awwal, the First
tomorrow: her hands were raw from the mill. what did her father give her?

segments.voice: A week of Names about power and time. Al-Ahad, unique. As-Samad, all need him. Al-Qadir, able. Al-Muqtadir, all power. Al-Muqaddim, brought forward. And yesterday, Al-Mu'akhkhir: put back. Today, the one who was there before any of them came up.
screen: `UNIQUE · ALL NEED HIM · ABLE.` → `ALL POWER · FORWARD · BACK.` → `AND BEFORE ALL OF IT?`

segments.voice: A café before sunrise: the key in the lock, the alarm, the lights, the first machine starting to hum. Some owners keep a ritual for that first minute. Yesterday's question was what Muslims say before the first word of anything. One word does it: bismillah. In the name of God. In full, it's the line that opens the Qur'an, in Pickthall's words: "In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful."
screen: `THE FIRST MINUTE OF THE DAY.` → `BISMILLAH.` → `IN THE NAME OF ALLAH.`

segments.voice: Bismillah isn't only for prayer. In Sahih al-Bukhari the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, tells a boy at the table to say it before he eats. Doors, car rides, a test, a hard text: ordinary beginnings are where it goes. And the reason sits in today's Name. Al-Awwal, the First. The Qur'an puts it in one verse with three more Names, which the next three days will open: "He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things." A du'a of the Prophet in Sahih Muslim spells out the first of them: You are the First, and there is nothing before You. So bismillah at the start of something small is a big thing: it puts the First first. Here's a detail to tell a friend tonight: the Qur'an itself opens with the same words, so the book starts where the café does. Now look back at this week from there. The Unique, whom all need. The Able, the All-Powerful. The one who brings forward and the one who puts back. Every one of them was already there before the first thing happened. Before your alarm. Before the café lights.
screen: `NOT ONLY FOR PRAYER.` · `THE FIRST AND THE LAST.` · `NOTHING BEFORE YOU.` · `PUT THE FIRST FIRST.` · then, large: `FIRST.`

segments.voice: Stand up and take a short, slow walk, even just across the room and back. Before the first step, say bismillah, or in the name of God, and let each step after belong to that first word. Then sit for whatever time is left.
Al-Awwal. The First, before everything, with nothing before Him: the opening Name of four in one verse.
The line to keep: first, before the alarm and before the first word. That's a week of Names, done.

chat.meaning: Al-Awwal is the First, with nothing before Him. Bismillah opens ordinary beginnings, a meal, a door, a decision, by putting the First first.
